description: Produce a standard-library Python module that turns recorded input/output pairs into a pytest module, plus pytest tests. Choose this when recorded input/output pairs must become one deterministic pytest case per pair. Do not choose this to test behaviour not covered by the recorded pairs, or to generate non-deterministic tests. Example requests: Write a Python module that turns recorded input/output pairs into a pytest module, with tests. | I have input/output examples and want a deterministic regression test suite. | Generate a regression-suite generator and prove it with pytest.
